manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {2}{W}.
When Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stonecloaker triggers, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Stonecloaker triggers, exiling two cards from any graveyard.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.
